current_role: Former U.S. representative from New York; co-chair of the Run Ro draft effort
summary: Jamaal Bowman, a former Bronx middle-school principal, beat 16-term incumbent Eliot Engel in the 2020 Democratic primary and served in the House from 2021 to 2025 as a member of the Squad. He lost renomination in 2024 to George Latimer in the most expensive House primary to that date, most of the outside money coming from AIPAC-linked groups. In November 2026 he launched a draft campaign for Ro Khanna.
